description: Logistic regression exercising the rounding direction of the fixed-point shift on a non-exact negative product

test_cases.description: w=-0.1 (raw -6554), x=0.1 (raw 6554): product -6554*6554 = -42954916 is not a multiple of 2^16, so the arithmetic shift floors toward negative infinity to -656 (true value -655.36), not -655
